CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_events
(
    event_date           Date         DEFAULT toDate(event_ts),
    event_ts             DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),

    user_id              UUID,
    role                 String,
    session_id           UUID,
    course_id            UUID,
    course_version_id    UUID,
    lesson_id            UUID,
    task_id              UUID,

    platform             LowCardinality(String),
    editor_mode          LowCardinality(String),

    client_ts            Nullable(DateTime64(3, 'UTC')),

    event_type           LowCardinality(String),
    payload              String
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY event_date
ORDER BY (task_id, user_id, session_id, event_ts);
